blurb: What motivated a man to leave hearth and home and strike out for the territories, challenges and dangers of the unknown? The stories lay in the heart of each man. The communities of Colter Pass, Cooke City, and Silver Gate, updated, yet unchanged since the early days are yours to explore and experience.Start here with our past and your future.
